summary: Build supplier segmentation, scorecards and improvement plans in a five-day course. Explore the outline and see how it fits your procurement role.
lede: Supplier relationship management helps procurement and supply practitioners align engagement with supplier value and criticality. Practical exercises cover supplier segmentation, KPI scorecards, risk assessment and converting review findings into owned improvement actions; learners also prepare engagement plans, share forward demand information and use supplier records or platforms as references.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for procurement and supply practitioners who work directly with supplier performance, risk, relationship reviews or improvement actions. It also suits adjacent contract and category roles that need to coordinate supplier expectations and internal decisions.
prerequisites: Foundation-level procurement or supply practice is expected. Familiarity with supplier interactions, KPIs or contract requirements will help you apply the exercises. No coding is required.
